summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of iWhistle B2B Partnership Portal. All major features tested and working correctly including backend APIs, frontend UI components, mobile responsiveness, and frontend-backend integration.
passed_tests: Backend API health check (/api/health) returns 200 OK
Backend root endpoint serves React app correctly
Partnership form submission API (/api/partnerships) creates records successfully
Partnership retrieval API (/api/partnerships) returns saved data
Hero section renders with gradient background, navigation, hero image, and CTA buttons
Navigation bar shows logo, all required links (Partnership, Pilot Program, Documents, Apply, Contact), and Get Started CTA
Navigation becomes sticky with proper styling on scroll
Partnership Overview section shows 6 feature cards with icons and descriptions
Pilot Program section shows Track A ($8/month) and Track B ($12/month) cards with correct pricing
Sample Investment Scenarios table renders with data rows
Success Metrics section shows 4 metric cards with proper structure
Documents section shows 4 document cards with Download PDF buttons
Partnership Agreement Form has Fill Form and Preview Agreement tabs working correctly
Form includes all required sections: Organization Information, Primary Contact, Program Details, Partner Champion, Pricing, and Signatory
Save Progress button saves form data to localStorage successfully
Preview Agreement tab shows generated agreement text with filled form data
Download Draft button accessible and functional
Pricing calculator correctly computes totals ($10 * 30 officials * 12 months * 80% = $2,880)
Contact CTA section with Schedule Discovery Call button and email link
Footer with Quick Links, Resources, and Contact columns
Mobile responsive navigation with hamburger menu opens and closes properly
Desktop navigation hidden on mobile, mobile navigation accessible
Hero CTA buttons stack vertically on mobile
Form sections responsive and accessible on mobile
Frontend-backend integration working through form submission and localStorage
